photos.file: A zebrafish with congenital malformation of the yolk sac.jpg
photos.desc: The yolk sac of this zebrafish was damaged during hatching. As a result, the contur of its head has changed. Interestingly the fish's contour now resembles a human's head!

A female zebrafish (Cyprinidae: Danio rerio ) and a male guppy (Poeciliidae: Poecilia reticulata ). To the right the head and pelvic fins of a Southern platyfish (Poeciliidae: Xiphophorus maculatus ).
